# shoehorn_notification_subscription (Resource)

Manages a Shoehorn notification subscription. A subscription routes platform events (CVEs, unhealthy workloads, approvals, digests) to a channel for a team or user. Channel secrets are referenced by `secret://` or `env://` ref only. Literal secrets are rejected and must be managed through the portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Route critical CVE events for a team to a Slack channel via an incoming webhook.
# The webhook URL lives in the customer's secret manager and is wired into the
# deployment as notifications.secrets. Terraform only references it.
resource "shoehorn_notification_subscription" "team_cve_slack" {
  scope    = "team"
  scope_id = shoehorn_team.platform.id

  name         = "Platform CVE alerts"
  event_types  = ["cve.detected", "cve.fix_available"]
  min_severity = "warning"
  cadence      = "realtime"

  channel_type = "slack"
  slack {
    mode       = "webhook"
    url_secret = "secret://slack-platform-webhook"
  }
}

# Send a daily digest of unhealthy workloads to an external webhook.
resource "shoehorn_notification_subscription" "team_digest_webhook" {
  scope    = "team"
  scope_id = shoehorn_team.platform.id

  name         = "Workload health digest"
  event_types  = ["workload.unhealthy"]
  min_severity = "info"
  cadence      = "daily"

  channel_type = "webhook"
  webhook {
    url            = "https://ops.example.com/hooks/shoehorn"
    signing_secret = "env://NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_SIGNING"
    content_type   = "application/json"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cadence` (String) The delivery cadence: `realtime`, `hourly`, `daily`, or `weekly`.
- `channel_type` (String) The channel type: `inapp`, `slack`, `email`, or `webhook`.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The set of event types the subscription matches. Must be non-empty.
- `min_severity` (String) The minimum severity to match: `info`, `warning`, or `critical`.
- `name` (String) The display name of the subscription (1-255 characters).
- `scope` (String) The subscription scope: `team` or `user`.
- `scope_id` (String) The UUID of the team or user the subscription belongs to.

### Optional

- `cadence_config` (String) Optional JSON-encoded cadence configuration object.
- `email` (Block, Optional) Email channel configuration. Set when `channel_type` is `email`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--email))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subscription is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `entity_filter` (String) Optional JSON-encoded entity filter object.
- `slack` (Block, Optional) Slack channel configuration. Set when `channel_type` is `slack`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--slack))
- `webhook` (Block, Optional) Webhook channel configuration. Set when `channel_type` is `webhook`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--webhook))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the subscription.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedblock--email"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email`

Optional:

- `recipients` (List of String) The list of recipient email addresses.


<a id="nestedblock--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `slack`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Slack delivery mode: `webhook` or `bot`.

Optional:

- `channel` (String) Slack channel name. Required for `bot` mode.
- `token_secret` (String) Reference to the bot token secret (`secret://NAME` or `env://VAR`). Required for `bot` mode.
- `url_secret` (String) Reference to the incoming webhook URL secret (`secret://NAME` or `env://VAR`). Required for `webhook` mode.


<a id="nestedblock--webhook"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhook`

Required:

- `signing_secret` (String) Reference to the request-signing secret (`secret://NAME` or `env://VAR`).
- `url` (String) The webhook URL to POST events to.

Optional:

- `content_type` (String) The request content type. Defaults to `application/json`.

## Import

Subscriptions are read by listing within their scope, so the import ID must
carry the scope and scope ID alongside the subscription ID:

```shell
terraform import shoehorn_notification_subscription.team_cve_slack team/<scope_id>/<subscription_id>
```
